description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the "Percent Sequence Ratio" on the x-axis and two different metrics on the y-axis: "Perplexity" and "GPU Mem. Ratio." The x-axis, labeled "Percent Sequence Ratio (%)," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis on the left, labeled "Perplexity," is also a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis on the right, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," is a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot features three lines: the orange line, representing "Perplexity," is a dashed line with circle markers; the blue line, representing "Full Cache PPL," is a solid line with circle markers; and the red line, representing "Full Cache GPU Mem. Ratio," is a dashed line with square markers. The "Perplexity" line shows a general decline from the start to the end of the x-axis, with a peak around the 20% mark. The "Full Cache PPL" line shows a steady increase from the start to the end of the x-axis. The "Full Cache GPU Mem. Ratio" line shows a sharp increase at the 80% mark, followed by a slight decline towards the end of the x-axis.
